facts.fact: NPC said birth and death registration moved to the digital VitalReg system from 1 July 2026 in all 36 states and the FCT, no longer on paper forms.
NPC chairman said it has established 4,011 functional registration centres across the 774 Local Government Areas and aims to reach about 8,000.

systems.country_label: Electronic Civil Registration and Vital Statistics system / VitalReg
